reapack.name: NVSD_ItemView.lua
reapack.desc: NVSD ItemView - Ableton-style clip view for REAPER items

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Initial release

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix crash when opening settings, fix context crash on macOS, improve dialog detection for autosave/preferences

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix crash when autosave/save-as dialog appears

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Reliable fix for crash when any modal dialog appears (autosave, save-as, render, preferences)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Audio preview (click waveform + Ctrl+Space), marker drag threshold, Ctrl fine-tune, fade clamping on pitch change, alt+click fade remove, fix waveform display (linear, symmetric, both halves), sparser grid on long samples, zoom-aware marker snapping

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Exact Bezier fade curves matching REAPER internals, auto-crossfade support, drag mutual exclusion (ruler/pan/fade/markers), fix alt+drag curvature removing fade at extremes, fix alt+drag both markers oscillating with snap, fade drag indicator line, correct shape icons, sparser grid, error logging

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Envelope editor: Volume/Pitch envelopes with node creation, freehand drawing, drag, alt+click delete, dropdown, undo/redo fix, correct z-ordering

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Marker drag to extend/shrink items beyond source boundaries with looped waveform, unified sample/envelope view, looped waveform display with dimmed loop regions and dashed boundary lines, envelope support for looped/extended items

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Preview and region selection work in looped/extended waveform regions, remembered item persists when REAPER selection goes to nil

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix looped item display when extending items in REAPER arrange view, unwrap tracking reset on item change

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Toggle action support (assign any shortcut to open/close), Escape to close window

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix marker drag feedback loop on looped items (stable drag sensitivity)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix view jump after marker drag release on looped items, fix undo view state, fix split-second flash on drag start

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: 18 themes (Custom color editor, 5 DAW-inspired), grid density fix, grid left-edge fix, tooltip 1.5s, fade_curves module, undo wrapper, 179 tests

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix custom theme color picker: use packed integer for ReaImGui ColorEdit3 API

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix shortcut docs (help tab/README), nil-safe theme colors, pcall undo wrapper, debounce custom color saves

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix Edit button not opening external editor (detect __default__ key in REAPER ini)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Custom themes: simplified 4-color editor (auto-derives 15 remaining), user-saveable themes, adaptive grid density, snap button, dynamic shortcut tooltips, scrollable settings, help/README/docs updates

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Appearance tab facelift: table layout with aligned columns, 3-segment color bars (bg|waveform|accent), hover tooltips for descriptions, cleaner user/built-in theme separation

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix custom theme background derivation: use additive offsets matching preset themes instead of multiplicative factors

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Theme-aware left panel: all controls (knobs, sliders, buttons, FX list, dropdowns) now use theme colors. btn_off derives from background, btn_text derives from text color.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Open take FX chain before FX browser so added FX targets the item instead of the track

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add missing reference shortcuts: Shift+Mouse4/5 for fades, double-click reset, Ctrl+drag fine control, right-click fade shape, left drag select

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add right-drag envelope node selection to reference shortcuts

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix envelope node drag resetting curve shape to linear (preserves shape and tension)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix envelope tension/segment drag selecting wrong segment with snap enabled, lock segment highlight during drag

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add alt+click FX button tip to FX LIST help section

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Pencil cursor when Ctrl held over envelope segments (freehand draw mode indicator), also shown during active freehand drawing

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Clean crosshair cursor for Ctrl draw mode (replaces pencil), add Ctrl+drag draw nodes hint to segment tooltips

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Bigger crosshair cursor for draw mode (10px arms, 1.5px thick)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Preserve full envelope when copying region selection (no trimming, markers define playback region)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Mouse 4/5 shortcuts now editable in Shortcuts tab (set start/end marker, set fade-in/out positions)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add zoom-to-markers shortcut (Z): zooms view to fit start/end marker region. Editable in Shortcuts tab. Fix syntax error from mouse button refactoring.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Zoom-to-markers (Z) is now a toggle: press once to zoom in, press again to restore previous zoom. Clears on manual zoom/pan/item change.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: New zoom shortcuts: Shift+Z unzooms completely, Alt+Z zooms to selected area (toggle). All editable in Shortcuts tab.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Swap zoom defaults: Shift+Z zooms to selected area, Alt+Z unzooms completely.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Simplified zoom: Z zooms to selected region (priority) or markers; press again to restore. Removed Shift+Z/Alt+Z.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add Alt+Z to unzoom completely (editable in Shortcuts tab).

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: C crops markers to selection (with envelope shift). Clear pitch/speed moved to Shift+C. Symbol keys ([ ] - = ; etc.) now bindable in Shortcuts tab.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Arrow keys (Up/Down/Left/Right) and numpad operators (+/-/*/./Enter) now bindable in Shortcuts tab.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Z with selection always zooms deeper (stackable). Z without selection restores to original zoom. Enables drill-down zoom workflow.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Z toggle fix: press Z to zoom to selection/markers, press Z again to restore. New selection zooms deeper, same selection or markers toggles back.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix: selection no longer lost when starting a new drag while zoomed in. Z now reliably zooms to selection at any zoom level.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Switch README banner to github cover.jpg

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix crop/zoom/envelope bugs for looped items

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix filename click to open Media Explorer at file directory

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add WAV cue marker display with click-to-select regions, change mute shortcut to Num0

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add shortcut conflict modal with reassign confirmation

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add conflict check to shortcut Reset button

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Apply shortcut changes immediately instead of requiring Save & Close

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Change open external editor shortcut from E to Ctrl+Alt+E

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix ruler label density on longer files

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix ruler missing numbers on right side - restore dim labels on intermediate bars

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix ruler label density when zoomed out on long files

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix Ctrl+drag near markers draws envelope instead of moving marker

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Show crosshair cursor over markers when Ctrl+envelope freehand mode active

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Suppress fade and cue marker hover during envelope freehand draw

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Show up/down cursor when Alt+hovering fade curve for tension drag

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Only highlight element that will actually be grabbed when fade and envelope overlap

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Show zone highlight when Alt+hovering over markers (slide both)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Suppress envelope highlight when Alt+hovering over marker (zone slide priority)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Prevent marker drag and envelope tension drag from firing simultaneously

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add Ctrl+F shortcut to show file in Media Explorer

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Warp mode: real-time start marker drag with stretch marker shifting, extend left to source start, mouse 4/5 quick-set, grid snap alignment

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Custom toolbar buttons in info bar: add REAPER action buttons via right-click or Settings, with icon support and popup positioning

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix stuck toggle state during auto-reload with heartbeat mechanism

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix Change Icon from context menu, improve popup positioning for edit and icon picker windows

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Direct icon picker opens above the button instead of below

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix popup modal dragging: skip cursor override when popup is open

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix ImGui_Attach overflow: stop clearing icon cache on every icon change

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Taller toolbar bar (36px) with 30px buttons matching REAPER icons, edit modal opens above button, fix popup title bar dragging over waveform

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Toolbar icons fill full 30x30 button size with no container box, subtle hover highlight only

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Drag-and-drop reorder for toolbar buttons with visual insertion indicator

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Vertically center all info bar elements, fix waveform icon stretching at taller bar height

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Edit toolbar modal opens above info bar so buttons stay visible, styled consistently with other modals (rounded corners, proper padding, colored buttons)

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Icon picker window bigger (620x640), scrollbar no longer clips right column, styled like other modals, centered "Text Only" button

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add X close button to icon picker window

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Bigger text (1.15x) in settings, edit modal, icon pickers, and confirm dialogs. Bigger frame padding, icon preview at real 30x30 size.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix: use CreateFont(15px) + PushFont/PopFont instead of non-existent SetWindowFontScale for bigger text in settings and popups

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix: remove font scaling code entirely (ReaImGui lacks PushFont/SetWindowFontScale). Increased padding and window sizes already improve readability.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Auto-fill button label from REAPER action name when pasting command ID. Gear and CUE buttons scale up to match toolbar button size.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Action search autocomplete in edit toolbar button modal. Streamlined context menu. Clickable icon preview. Centered edit modal. Fix stale icon cache on context recreation.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Add 4px color strip at top showing item/track color.

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix Mac knob/slider drag (runtime mouse event suppression detection), fix non-looped item display and alt-drag, real-time item visual updates during drag, improved source length caching

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Fix hover highlight bleeding to neighboring controls during Mac knob/slider drag, remove debug overlay

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog: Edge auto-scroll: knob/slider drags continue past screen boundary on Mac, suppress hover bleed to neighboring controls during drag

version.author: NVSD

version.changelog: Fix Cmd+C copy-selection on macOS (VKey fallback when REAPER consumes keypress before ImGui)

version.changelog: Improved edge auto-scroll for HiDPI/Retina displays, fallback direction from overall drag delta
